def test_g08_component_equals_twin_at_every_passes_entry(): """For every listing entry labelled `passes`, on this platform, in one process: the expected outcome from the twin (§3.10 adapter) equals the component's outcome, and accepted h and phi are bit-identical (signed zeros included). Any twin exception other than ArithmeticError or ValueError raises TwinStopError: a STOP, never a skipped point.""" from tars.sim import geodesy from tests import s2_dl4_point_sets as gen from tests.s2_dl4_geodetic_twin import twin_outcome
entries = gen.parse_listing((REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "s2_dl4_points.txt").read_text()) passes = [e for e in entries if e.label == "passes"] assert len(passes) == 22601 mismatches = [] for e in passes: expected = twin_outcome(e.x, e.y, e.z) try: h, phi = geodesy.geodetic((e.x, e.y, e.z)) actual = "accepted" except geodesy.GeodeticDomainError as exc: actual = exc.reason if actual != expected.outcome: mismatches.append((e.set, e.index, expected.outcome, actual)) elif actual == "accepted": rec = expected.record same_h = struct.pack("<d", h) == struct.pack("<d", rec.h) same_phi = struct.pack("<d", phi) == struct.pack("<d", rec.phi) if not (same_h and same_phi): mismatches.append((e.set, e.index, "accepted bits", h.hex(), rec.h.hex())) > assert mismatches == [], f"stop 3: {len(mismatches)} G-08 mismatches: {mismatches[:10]}" E AssertionError: stop 3: 19776 G-08 mismatches: [("PS-A'", 80, 'accepted bits', '-0x1.3880000000200p+13', '-0x1.3880000000000p+13'), ("PS-A'", 81, 'accepted bits', '-0x1.9000000010000p+6', '-0x1.9000000000000p+6'), ("PS-A'", 83, 'accepted bits', '0x1.0000000000000p+0', '0x1.fffffff800000p-1'), ("PS-A'", 84, 'accepted bits', '0x1.869ffffffff00p+14', '0x1.86a0000000000p+14'), ("PS-A'", 85, 'accepted bits', '0x1.86a0000000000p+16', '0x1.869ffffffffc0p+16'), ("PS-A'", 86, 'accepted bits', '0x1.e847fffffffe0p+17', '0x1.e848000000000p+17'), ("PS-A'", 87, 'accepted bits', '0x1.b773ffffffff8p+19', '0x1.b774000000000p+19'), ("PS-A'", 88, 'accepted bits', '0x1.e847ffffffff8p+19', '0x1.e848000000000p+19'), ("PS-A'", 89, 'accepted bits', '0x1.e847ffffffffcp+20', '0x1.e848000000000p+20'), ("PS-A'", 90, 'accepted bits', '-0x1.3880000000200p+13', '-0x1.3880000000000p+13')] E assert [("PS-A'", 80...00p+17'), ...] == [] E E Left contains 19776 more items, first extra item: ("PS-A'", 80, 'accepted bits', '-0x1.3880000000200p+13', '-0x1.3880000000000p+13') E Use -v to get more diff
